subject: general
question: Find the value of k, if 18% of 450 = 30% of k.
solution:
Given:

18% of 450 = 30% of k

Calculation:

18% of 450 = 30% of k

⇒ 0.18 × 450 = 0.3 × k

⇒ 81 = 0.3k

⇒ k = 81/0.3

⇒ k = 270

∴ The value of k is 270.
